## Functional summary

The 474-aa sequence is most consistent with **MurE ligase** (UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate–meso-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase; **EC 6.3.2.13**). It likely catalyzes the ATP-dependent addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to a peptidoglycan precursor:

**UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP → UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H⁺**

This reaction extends the peptide stem of a bacterial cell-wall building block. **Mg²⁺** is annotated as a cofactor.

The assignment is supported by strong similarity to reviewed MurE proteins, including UniProt **Q9RNM2** (57.0% identity; 97.7% query coverage) and additional reviewed homologs. Thus, the function is well supported by homology, but the supplied sequence itself has not been experimentally characterized here. **Rhea: RHEA:23676.**
